generate_text_vertexai: generate text using the VertexAIAPI class with gemini-2.0-flash model and configurable temperature
generate_texts_batch: generate multiple text samples from a single prompt using VertexAIAPI.generate_texts with candidate_count
chat_conversation: chat with the VertexAIAPI class using a sequence of user and model messages with system instruction support
embed_text_content: embed text content into a vector representation using VertexAIAPI.embed with textembedding-gecko model
count_tokens_content: count tokens in text content using VertexAIAPI.count_tokens with the gemini-2.0-flash model
